LanguageData.Felinoid_Meat.label: felinoid meat
LanguageData.Felinoid_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a felinoid.
LanguageData.Gorg_Meat.label: gorg meat
LanguageData.Gorg_Meat.description: A piece of meat from an amphibian.
LanguageData.Gornt_Meat.label: gornt meat
LanguageData.Gornt_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a gornt. It is reputed to taste exceptional and commands a price that matches the fact.
LanguageData.GreenMilk.label: green milk
LanguageData.GreenMilk.description: Green milk from a reek. The high tannin content makes this milk quite bitter, but it can be cooked to remove the taste.
LanguageData.GundarkSkull.label: gundark skull
LanguageData.GundarkSkull.description: A gundark skull. These fearsome trophies were often displayed to show-off hunting prowess.
LanguageData.HoraxMaw.label: horax maw
LanguageData.HoraxMaw.description: The upper maw and horn of a mighty Horax. It holds great significance in Nelvaanian culture as its presence tells of a successful Horax hunt.
LanguageData.Insectile_Meat.label: insectile meat
LanguageData.Insectile_Meat.description: A piece of meat from an insectile.
LanguageData.JakobeastHorn.label: jakobeast horn
LanguageData.JakobeastHorn.description: A horn from a Jakobeast. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it is beautiful and sells for a decent price due to it's "mysterious properties".
LanguageData.JakobeastHorn.tools.point.label: point
LanguageData.JakobeastHorn.tools.base.label: base
LanguageData.Krayt_Meat.label: krayt meat
LanguageData.Krayt_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a large reptiloid.
LanguageData.KraytDragonHorn.label: krayt dragon horn
LanguageData.KraytDragonHorn.description: A krayt dragon's horn. Good enough to fend off some enemies. A valuable and potentially useful weapon if needed.
LanguageData.KraytDragonHorn.tools.point.label: point
LanguageData.KraytDragonHorn.tools.base.label: base
LanguageData.KraytDragonSkull.label: krayt dragon skull
LanguageData.KraytDragonSkull.description: A krayt dragon skull. Not only is it intimidating but its presence tells of a great hunt.
LanguageData.KraytPearl.label: krayt pearl
LanguageData.KraytPearl.description: A krayt pearl from the stomach of a greater krayt dragon. This is a relic of a truly legendary hunt.
LanguageData.Leather_Bantha.label: bantha fur
LanguageData.Leather_Bantha.description: Tanned, dried, bantha fur. Not the toughest material, but very insulative against the heat.
LanguageData.Leather_Bright.label: bright fur
LanguageData.Leather_Bright.description: The pelt of an creature typically associated with the "lightside". This beautiful fur protects very well and is believed to increase ones "connection to the force".
LanguageData.Leather_Crustapod.label: crustapod chitin
LanguageData.Leather_Crustapod.description: Tanned, dried, crustapod chitin. Durable, but lacks insulation.
LanguageData.Leather_Dark.label: dark hide
LanguageData.Leather_Dark.description: The pelt of an creature typically associated with the "darkside". This tough skin protects very well and is believed to increase ones "connection to the force".
LanguageData.Leather_Fambaa.label: fambaa hide
LanguageData.Leather_Fambaa.description: The pelt of an Fambaa. Harvested from a large, hardy animal. This thick skin protects very well.
LanguageData.Leather_Felinoid.label: felinoid fur
LanguageData.Leather_Felinoid.description: Tanned, dried, felinoid fur. Soft and beautiful.
LanguageData.Leather_Gundark.label: gundark pelt
LanguageData.Leather_Gundark.description: The pelt of a Gundark. Harvested from a large, predatory animal. This hide protects reasonably well and is quite beautiful.
LanguageData.Leather_Horax.label: horax hide
LanguageData.Leather_Horax.description: Tanned, dried, Horax hide. Strong, durable and pricey.
LanguageData.Leather_Insectile.label: insectile hide
LanguageData.Leather_Insectile.description: Tanned, dried, insectile skin. It is suprisingly tough but insulates poorly.
LanguageData.Leather_Insectine.label: insectine chitin
LanguageData.Leather_Insectine.description: The shell of a insectine. It provides decent protection and insulates well against the cold.
LanguageData.Leather_KraytDragon.label: krayt hide
LanguageData.Leather_KraytDragon.description: Tanned, dried, krayt dragon scales. Exceptionally strong and commands a hefty price.
LanguageData.Leather_LavaFlea.label: lava flea chitin
LanguageData.Leather_LavaFlea.description: The shell of a Lava Flea. It is exceptionally resistant to high temperature, but only provide average protection.
LanguageData.Leather_Mammavian.label: mammavian hide
LanguageData.Leather_Mammavian.description: Tanned, dried, skin. It is quite insulative.
LanguageData.Leather_Nerf.label: nerf hide
LanguageData.Leather_Nerf.description: Tanned, dried, nerf hide. A popular clothing textile.
LanguageData.Leather_Rancor.label: rancor hide
LanguageData.Leather_Rancor.description: Tanned, dried, Rancor hide. Strong, durable and pricey.
LanguageData.Leather_Reptavian.label: reptavian hide
LanguageData.Leather_Reptavian.description: Tanned, dried, skin. It is tough and somewhat beautiful.
LanguageData.Leather_ReptoFur.label: reptomammal fur
LanguageData.Leather_ReptoFur.description: Tanned, dried, reptomammal fur. Smells bad but at least it insulates against the cold.
LanguageData.Leather_Reptomammal.label: reptomammal hide
LanguageData.Leather_Reptomammal.description: Tanned, dried, skin. It is tough and insulative.
LanguageData.Leather_Roggwart.label: roggwart hide
LanguageData.Leather_Roggwart.description: The pelt of a Roggwart. Harvested from a large, predatory animal. This hide protects reasonably well and is heat resistant.
LanguageData.Leather_Ronto.label: ronto hide
LanguageData.Leather_Ronto.description: The pelt of an Ronto. Harvested from a large, hardy animal. This thick skin protects very well.
LanguageData.Leather_Rycrit.label: rycrit hide
LanguageData.Leather_Rycrit.description: The hide of an Rycrit. Known for it's insulative properties above it protective ones.
LanguageData.Leather_Saurian.label: saurian hide
LanguageData.Leather_Saurian.description: Tanned, dried, saurian skin. It has an unusual beauty.
LanguageData.Leather_SoftFur.label: soft fur
LanguageData.Leather_SoftFur.description: Tanned, dried, soft fur. Soft, insulating and beautiful.
LanguageData.Leather_Testudine.label: testudine chitin
LanguageData.Leather_Testudine.description: The shell of a testudine. It provides excellent protection but does not insulate well.
LanguageData.Leather_Tough.label: heavy hide
LanguageData.Leather_Tough.description: Tanned, dried, skin. It won't keep you warm but it is reasonably durable.
LanguageData.Leather_Vapaad.label: vapaad chitin
LanguageData.Leather_Vapaad.description: The shell of a Vapaad. It is exceptionally resistant to high temperature and provides decent protection.
LanguageData.Leather_Wampa.label: wampa pelt
LanguageData.Leather_Wampa.description: Tanned, dried, wampa pelt. Reasonable protection and keeps you warm.
LanguageData.Leather_Wraid.label: wraidskin
LanguageData.Leather_Wraid.description: The hide of an Wraid. Harvested from a large, hardy animal. This thick skin protects well and command a decent price.
LanguageData.Leather_Zakkeg.label: zakkeg hide
LanguageData.Leather_Zakkeg.description: The pelt of a Zakkeg. Harvested from a large, predatory animal. This hide protects very well but isn't insulative.
LanguageData.Mammavian_Meat.label: mammavian meat
LanguageData.Mammavian_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a mammavian.
LanguageData.MankaTooth.label: manka tooth
LanguageData.MankaTooth.description: A manka cats tooth. While not ideal as a melee weapon, it's true value comes in the strange curative properties experienced when held.
LanguageData.MankaTooth.tools.point.label: point
LanguageData.MankaTooth.tools.base.label: base

LanguageData.MastmotTusk.tools.point.label: point
LanguageData.MastmotTusk.tools.base.label: base

LanguageData.Nerf_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a nerf.
LanguageData.NerfHorn.label: nerf horn
LanguageData.NerfHorn.description: A horn from a Nerf, can be used as a weapon or sold for profit.
LanguageData.NerfHorn.tools.point.label: point
LanguageData.NerfHorn.tools.base.label: base
LanguageData.NexuTongue.label: nexu tongue
LanguageData.NexuTongue.description: The raw tongue of a nexu creature. These tongues are considered an exotic delicacy when eaten cooked.
LanguageData.Pachydermoid_Meat.label: pachydermoid meat
LanguageData.Pachydermoid_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a pachydermoid.
LanguageData.Rancor_Meat.label: rancor meat
LanguageData.Rancor_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a rancor.
LanguageData.RancorSkull.label: rancor skull
LanguageData.RancorSkull.description: A rancor skull. Not only is it intimidating and beautiful at the same time, it speaks volumes .
LanguageData.RancorTooth.label: rancor tooth
LanguageData.RancorTooth.description: A rancors tooth. Good enough to fend off some enemies. A valuable and potentially useful weapon if needed.
LanguageData.RancorTooth.tools.point.label: point
LanguageData.RancorTooth.tools.base.label: base
LanguageData.Reptavian_Meat.label: reptavian meat
LanguageData.Reptavian_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a reptavian.
LanguageData.Reptomammal_Meat.label: reptomammal meat
LanguageData.Reptomammal_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a reptomammal.
LanguageData.RikknitOvum.label: rikknit ovum
LanguageData.RikknitOvum.description: The raw ovum sac of a rikknit creature. These are considered a delicacy when eaten, but they can be processed into an addictive substance called ji rikknit.
LanguageData.Rodentia_Meat.label: rodentia meat
LanguageData.Rodentia_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a rodent.
LanguageData.Ronto_Meat.label: ronto meat
LanguageData.Ronto_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a ronto.
LanguageData.Rycrit_Meat.label: rycrit meat
LanguageData.Rycrit_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a rycrit. It is reputed to taste great and is a staple of Rylothian cuisine.
LanguageData.SarlacciSpore.label: sarlacci spore
LanguageData.SarlacciSpore.description: The spore of a sarlacc creature. It appears dormant and whilst ugly, it is no less valuable as a naturally occuring curiosity.
LanguageData.Saurian_Meat.label: saurian meat
LanguageData.Saurian_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a saurian.
LanguageData.Silica_Meat.label: silica meat
LanguageData.Silica_Meat.description: A piece of meat from a silicon based life form.
LanguageData.SkalderTusk.label: skalder tusk
LanguageData.SkalderTusk.description: A skalder tusk. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it can still be deadly.
LanguageData.SkalderTusk.tools.point.label: point
LanguageData.SkalderTusk.tools.base.label: base
LanguageData.TachGland.label: tach gland
LanguageData.TachGland.description: The raw gland extracted from the brain of a tach creature. They should generally not be eaten (but can be cooked) but instead they are can be used to produce tarisian ale.
LanguageData.TaozinNodule.label: taozin nodule
LanguageData.TaozinNodule.description: A Taozin nodule is a piece of carapace with unusual properties. This rare curiosity has the ability make the holder "difficult to percieve in the force".
LanguageData.Tender_Meat.label: tender meat
LanguageData.Tender_Meat.description: A piece of tender, fatty meat from a generally sedentary creature.
LanguageData.Tough_Meat.label: tough meat
LanguageData.Tough_Meat.description: A piece of tough, chewy meat from a generally active creature.
LanguageData.TukataSpike.label: tuk'ata tail spike
LanguageData.TukataSpike.description: The poisonous tail spike of a Tuk'ata. Good enough to fend off most living enemies.
LanguageData.TukataSpike.tools.point.label: point
LanguageData.TukataSpike.tools.edge.label: edge
LanguageData.TukataSpike.tools.base.label: base
LanguageData.WampaSkull.label: wampa skull
LanguageData.WampaSkull.description: A wampa skull. These fearsome trophies were often displayed to show-off hunting prowess.
LanguageData.WarWyrmSkull.label: war wyrm skull
LanguageData.WarWyrmSkull.description: A war wyrm skull. This is a relic of a truly legendary hunt.
LanguageData.WoolBantha.label: bantha wool
LanguageData.WoolBantha.description: Soft, light and provides very good insulation. Wool clothes can keep the body warm even in extreme conditions.
LanguageData.WoolCoarse.label: coarse wool
LanguageData.WoolCoarse.description: While somewhat coarse, this wool offers some insulation.
LanguageData.WoolMastmot.label: mastmot wool
LanguageData.WoolMastmot.description: While somewhat matted, mastmot wool's interlocking fibers make it exceptionally warm.
LanguageData.WoolNerf.label: nerf wool
LanguageData.WoolNerf.description: Soft, light and provides very good insulation. Wool clothes can keep the body warm even in extreme conditions.
LanguageData.WoolTaozin.label: taozin silk
LanguageData.WoolTaozin.description: Sticky insectoid silk-wool squeezed from a taozins labial glands, it offers reasonable insulation and unusually decreases ones "connection to the force".
LanguageData.WoolWyyyschokk.label: wyyyschokk silk
LanguageData.WoolWyyyschokk.description: Sticky insectoid silk-wool squeezed from a wyyyschokk labial glands, it offers reasonable insulation and is resilient.
